name: Task-only Wyvern Cave (Fossil Island)
accessNote: Task-only Fossil Island Wyvern Cave trapdoor inside the Mushroom Forest. Requires a Fossil Island Wyverns slayer task; Weve stops players attacking here without the task. Contains 4 Spitting, 4 Taloned, 4 Long-tailed, and 3 Ancient Wyverns, with a Fossil Storage box by the entrance.
